```{r,echo=FALSE}
gcd2 <- function(a, b) {
  if (b == 0) a else Recall(b, a %% b)
}
gcd <- function(...) Reduce(gcd2, c(...))

# (a+b*sqrt(c))*(a-b*sqrt(c))

while(T){
    a = sample(2:9,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
    b = sample(2:7,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
    c = sample(2:7,1)
    sol = a^2-b^2*c
    if(abs(sol)>1 && abs(sol)<100 && abs(b^2*c)<100 && length(unique(abs(c(a,b,c))))==3){break}
}

ex1 = paste0("(",a,"+",b,"\\sqrt{",c,"})\\cdot(",a,"+",-b,"\\sqrt{",c,"})")
ex1 = gsub("+-","-",ex1,fixed=T)

ex2 = paste0("(",a,")^2+",-a*b,"\\sqrt{",c,"}+",a*b,"\\sqrt{",c,"}+(",b,"\\sqrt{",c,"})(",-b,"\\sqrt{",c,"})")
ex2 = gsub("+-","-",ex2,fixed=T)

ex3 = paste0(a^2,"-",b^2,"\\cdot",c)

ex4 = paste0(a^2,"-",b^2*c)

```

Question
========

In the expression below is a product of a pair of [conjugates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conjugate_(square_roots)).

$$`r ex1`$$

This product simplifies to an integer; find that integer.


Solution
========

You should FOIL (or use box method).

$$`r ex2`$$

Notice the two middle terms cancel each other out. Also, $(`r a`)^2=`r a^2`$ and $`r b`\cdot`r b`=`r b^2`$ and $\sqrt{`r c`}\cdot\sqrt{`r c`}=`r c`$.

$$`r ex3`$$

$$`r ex4`$$

$$`r sol`$$
